output.scope_note: The paper is about predicting effective Li-ion conductivity of polycrystalline Li7La3Zr2O12 (LLZO) solid electrolyte microstructures, but its only explicit conductivity number is a literature-cited grain conductivity used as a simulation input.

records.evidence_quote: 1.335×10-5 S/m, which are the reported values for LLZO ceramics [31]
records.evidence_location: Section 3.2 (Calculation of the effective ion conductivities)
records.notes: Not a result of this paper: this is the local grain Li-ion conductivity set as a simulation input, taken from ref. [31]. No measurement temperature is given. The paper reports no absolute effective-conductivity values, only MARE percentages, so no computed records were made. The grain-boundary values are given only as scaling factors (10^r), not as absolute values.
